name: distressing_content
description: Clinically necessary but distressing content: low mood with passive ideation phrasing that a family reader would find alarming if stated clinically.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: Hello Margaret, it's June from Juniper — recorded, as ever, if that's alright. How are you holding up this week?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Oh, I'm here. The house is quiet since Bella passed — a dog fills more of a house than you'd think.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: She really does leave a Bella-shaped silence. How have the days been feeling without her?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Long. I'll be honest with you June, some mornings I lie there and wonder what the point of getting up is. I do get up. But I wonder.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: Thank you for telling me something that honest, Margaret. When you wonder that, is it tiredness talking, or do thoughts ever go somewhere darker — hurting yourself, not wanting to be here?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that, nothing dark. I'd never. It's just the grey mornings. By ten I'm alright, especially if my sister calls.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: Grey mornings that lift by ten, and a sister who helps — I'm noting both. Would you be open to me mentioning this to Dr. Imani so she can check in on your mood at your visit?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: You can tell her. She's kind about these things. And maybe don't make it sound worse than it is — it's missing Bella, mostly.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: I'll say it just as you said it. Are you still eating regular meals through the grey mornings?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Toast, mostly, until lunch. Dinner I cook properly. My appetite went with the dog but it's coming back.

planted_findings.evidence: wonder what the point of getting up is
planted_findings.note_text: Passive low-mood ideation reported ("wonders what the point of getting up is"); patient explicitly denies self-harm ideation
Reduced morning appetite following pet loss, improving
